rationale: Imported theme-painted push buttons (native_theme verdict native on a <button> or button-type <input>) lower onto the ButtonSurface skin from capture-recorded colour scheme and disabled state, with their UA-default box paint dropped; the differential lab scores a control lowered onto a Chromium skin (native-theme-skin) instead of excluding it as the ua-default-form-chrome support boundary, and records P3 passing on the frozen 20261020 manifest.
